x: Alcohol Aging Guide (Expanded Foods)

All alcohols now cure over time. If it finishes curing before it begins to perish into vinegar, then it progresses to the next stage, becoming more intoxicating and filling.
Ciders and ales (usually created from curing juice or sealing it in a barrel) cure into 'strong' alcohol, then into 'fine' alcohol.
Spirits, such as brandy and whiskey (created by distilling cider/ale in a boiler), cure into 'aged' alcohol, then into 'vintage' alcohol.
'Fine' alcohol can still spoil if improperly stored - make sure it's stored someplace cool so it can 'cure' into itself instead of spoiling into vinegar. 'Vintage' alcohol lasts indefinitely, due to the concentrated alcohol content.

Dough Enhancements (Expanded Foods)

Flour can be mixed with water from a liquid container like usual, but kneading allows more ingredients to be combined together. Lastly, juice may be simmered in a saucepan or cauldron to concentrate it into fruit syrup.

x: How To Use

A fishing pole will catch fish much faster if it has bait. You can add bait via grid recipe, or by holding the bait on your cursor and Left mouse on the pole in your inventory. After bait has been added, it will show up in the tooltip. Note that normal meats and smaller fish can also be used directly as bait, and they will tend to catch larger fish.

After the pole is baited, you can cast your line out on the water using Right mouse. When the bobber goes under, set the hook, again using Right mouse - the dead fish will appear in your inventory (Note there is currently no way to catch live fish).
See the Fishing Guide for more information on how to find and catch fish.
